arena: [분담] Life Cocoon encases the target for 12 sec, absorbing heavy damage and increasing periodic healing taken by 50%. Put it on the ally the enemy burst cooldowns are focused on.
[광역 피해] With Peaceweaver, Revival's cooldown drops by 16% and it grants 2 sec of immunity to magic damage and harmful effects. Use Revival when enemy magic burst or AoE CC is coming in.

[해제] Detox removes all magic, poison and disease effects from an ally, and Revival removes 3 harmful magic effects plus poisons and diseases from party members within 40 yds at once. Use Revival when several allies are CC'd.

[우선 처치] With Zen Spheres, a sphere appears over the target hit by Rising Sun Kick, increasing their damage taken by 10% and reducing their damage dealt by 3%. Put Rising Sun Kick on your team's kill target.
[위치] With Eminence, you can swap places with your Transcendence spirit even while stunned. Leave the spirit near a pillar and swap when a stun and burst line up.
[제어] Paralysis incapacitates a target within 20 yds but damage can break it. Use it on an enemy your team isn't hitting; Leg Sweep stuns enemies within 6 yds for 3 sec.
[차단] With Zen Focus Tea, Thunder Focus Tea grants 5 sec of immunity to silences and interrupts. Pop it before a long heal cast while the enemy interrupt is up.
[생존기] Fortifying Brew turns your skin to stone for 15 sec. Pop it when you start getting focused.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 2 healers, and on flag maps a mobile healer is a good carrier. You can take the carry with 2 Roll charges and the root and slow removal from Tiger's Lust on yourself.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than healing, put damage-absorbing Life Cocoon on the flag carrier or focused ally first.
[분담] Tiger's Lust removes roots and slows from an ally and increases movement speed by 70% for 6 sec. Use it on your rooted flag carrier.

[제어] Ring of Peace knocks back enemies entering the ring, but feared or disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Drop it on the path enemies without CC on them take into a base or toward your flag carrier.
[해제] Revival removes 3 harmful magic effects plus poisons and diseases from party members within 40 yds. Use it when several CC effects land on allies stacked on base defense.
pvpTalents: Zen Spheres, picked by all top 48 Solo Shuffle players and 39 of 44 Battleground Blitz players, creates a sphere on your Rising Sun Kick target that increases their damage taken by 10%. Peaceweaver, picked by 47 of 48 Solo Shuffle and 39 of 44 Battleground Blitz players, adds 2 sec of magic immunity to Revival. Eminence, picked by 36 of 48 Solo Shuffle players, lets you swap places with Transcendence even while stunned.

Soothing Mist, Crackling Jade Lightning, and Rising Sun Kick form a sphere of Hope or Despair above their targets. Only one of each sphere can be active at a time.

Sphere of Hope: Increases your healing done to the target by 10%.
Sphere of Despair: Target deals 3% less damage and takes 10% increased damage from all sources.

1243554.d:
위안의 안개와 짜릿한 비취 번개, 해오름차기 사용 시 대상의 머리 위에 희망 또는 절망의 구슬을 형성합니다. 각 구슬은 한 번에 하나씩만 활성화됩니다.

희망의 구슬: 대상에 대한 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.
절망의 구슬: 대상이 자신에게 입히는 피해를 3%만큼 감소시키고 대상이 받는 모든 피해는 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.
